newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH BANKING SECTOR CLIMATE INDEX EASES IN AUG.
newsitem.headline: POLISH BANKING SECTOR CLIMATE INDEX EASES IN AUG.

text.p: Poland's banking climate index fell 0.6 point to 51 points in August after rising 4.8 points in July, a poll released on Tuesday by the private Pentor institute showed.
The monthly survey showed the so-called "Pengab" index dipped due to the central bank's (NBP) decision last week to raise base credit rates by 2-2.5 percent to 27 and 24.5 percent respectively.
The index is based on a scale of minus 100 to plus 100. The poll was done on 207 bank managers and is commissioned monthly by the Polish Banking Association (ZBP).
